Optional hourly background sync

After one reviewed import, explicitly enable the saved hourly mode, types and recent-day span. Snapshot mode only adds or updates records. Reconciliation can include complete changed parent records outside that date range. Automatic deletions and removal of obsolete samples or unavailable aggregates require separate approval. Without approval, a batch requiring removals is held whole for foreground review. Missing snapshot records are never deleted. Android controls timing; the PC and Tailscale must be available.
